_doc: Registries we know are blocking an image for a while (tests/check_docker_pins.py): an image that starts with a prefix here is reported BLOCKED instead of GONE and does not fail the check until the date in until (YYYY-MM-DD) has passed. Remove the entry once the images are back, and re-pin.
